title: UI风格#96 - Venetian Carnival (威尼斯狂欢节)
description: 创建第96种UI风格：威尼斯狂欢节风格 - 华丽面具、羽毛装饰、拜占庭金色。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival style When color palette Then features masquerade gold, deep crimson, midnight blue, pearl white
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#DAA520 (面具金), #8B0000 (深红), #191970 (午夜蓝), #FFFAF0 (珍珠白), #4B0082 (靛蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival style When typography Then uses ornate fonts: Cinzel Decorative, Uncial Antiqua, or Playfair Display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cinzel Decorative (标题), Uncial Antiqua (装饰), Playfair Display (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival style When layout Then ornate frames, mask motifs, feathered borders, canal gradients
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：华丽边框、面具图案、羽毛装饰、运河渐变

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival style When UI elements Then mask animations, feather flourishes, gold leaf textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：面具动画、羽毛华丽、金箔质感、闪烁效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival UI When functional Then includes masquerade chat, performer agents, festival stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：化妆舞会聊天、表演者代理、节日统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Venetian Carnival UI When copy Then uses theatrical language: 'Masquerade', 'Feast', 'Mystery', 'Splendor'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'MASQUERADE. SPLENDOR. MYSTERY.'、按钮'SEND'→'PERFORM'、'SUBMIT'→'CELEBRATE'
